stories.title: Testimony begins in the trial of rapper Tupac Shakur's 1996 killing
stories.summary: Opening statements began Monday in the murder trial of rapper Tupac Shakur. The man implicated in the 1996 killing in Las Vegas is a former gang member.

stories.title: A summer camp celebrating Kazakh culture helps adopted kids connect with their culture
stories.summary: Families of children adopted from Kazakhstan meet every summer in New Hampshire's lake country to celebrate the food and culture of their country of origin.

stories.title: A uranium revival brings new worries to tribal lands
stories.summary: Uranium production has been revived in the US Southwest. Tribal communities there who suffered illnesses from previous development are worried nuclear energy will harm them again.

stories.title: Florida GOP race draws accusations of carpetbagging
stories.summary: "Carpetbagger" describes people who move somewhere to run for office. In Southwest Florida, six former congressional hopefuls from other states are taking their shot in this conservative stronghold.

stories.title: Palestinian American family in West Bank fear settler violence will rob them of home
stories.summary: A Palestinian-American remains holed up in his West Bank home for more than a week after Israeli settlers laid siege to the house and the Israeli army then turned it into a closed military area.

stories.title: Jared Kushner pushes for progress on a Gaza deal
stories.summary: President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner is trying to move Gaza talks forward. He met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu a day after meeting with Hamas, but key disagreements remain.
